pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients. The spatial area of patches is largest on the upper flank and becomes progressively smaller and more fragmented toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white negative space forming a Voronoi-like graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank with slight tapering at the nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, dark-colored mane along the neck-to-shoulder transition. The 1D silhouette against the background displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serration consistent with individual hair tufts.

other_distinctive_markers: Two small avian symbionts (oxpeckers) are perched on the dorsal ridge; one is located on the mid-neck and a second is positioned on the upper shoulder.
